# IRONSTICK

> Complete offline-first legal case-management for Windows & Android with a built-in AI that knows your files: clients, cases, evidence, deadlines, e-mail, documents.

**In short:**
- Works fully without any AI. AI providers — one or several, the user's choice — and the desktop-AI bridges are separately licensed add-ons.
- Local and encrypted: database, document store, configuration and AI scratch store are AES-256-encrypted at rest on the firm's own storage; the software vendor never sees client data. External AI runs only with the firm's own API key or desktop-AI account, and every data flow is listed in the GDPR declaration.
- In productive daily use by several lawyers, with single cases of more than 3,000 documents and more than 2,500 entities.
- Before a pleading leaves, IRONSTICK checks it against the case file and runs a review chain that ends with the Snake and Nucleu rounds (see Terms).

IRONSTICK is legal case-management software for Windows and Android tablets that runs locally on the lawyer's computer, in eleven languages. Every page of www.ironstick.legal is available below as Markdown in a plain-text file (`.md`, also as `.md`); the HTML page named in each file is the original.

## Terms
Nucleu and Snake are IRONSTICK's own terms and stay unchanged in every language.
- **Nucleu** — the binding core line of a case, or of a matter (a group of cases): written and approved by the lawyer, versioned. Every AI must read it before working on the case, and every pleading is checked against it.
- **Snake** — the register of the opposing side's proven lies and contradictions in a case; each entry carries the statement, the counter-statement and the evidence in between.
- **Digest** — the summary IRONSTICK keeps of every document (date, type, title, capture summary, cross-references, text size); work on a case starts from the digests of all its documents.
- **Gates** — deterministic program checks (plain logic, no AI) that refuse a step until its conditions are met.
- **Bridge** — the local connection through which a desktop AI app (Claude, ChatGPT, Qwen or Kimi) reads the case files with IRONSTICK's tools.
- **Review chain** — the fixed sequence of checks every pleading runs through before it can be delivered.

## Status: in productive use
- In productive daily use by several lawyers — not a prototype.
- Manages single cases with more than 3,000 documents and more than 2,500 entities.
- Prepares one submission-ready template of a court filing after another.
- The lawyers using it report how simple it is to operate and the massive time saved.

## Large and long-running case files
- IRONSTICK holds the complete file: every document as the original file and, in the database, in pre-processed form for the AI — full text and digest. The AI is served the facts on demand, live from the file, never from its own memory ([bridge](https://www.ironstick.legal/bridge.md)).
- Before the facts reach the AI they are prepared so that (a) the factual basis stays stable and (b) they arrive in portions the AI can work completely into the pleading.
- Every pleading runs through the same review chain, whatever the size of the case: read again in full; compared with the client's own earlier filings and, for a reply, with every point of the opposing document; attacked from the opposing side (ATAC); optimized (OPTIM); the Snake round; finally the Nucleu round ([bridge manual](https://www.ironstick.legal/manualbridge.md)).
- Snake round: the AI first asks the user whether it should run. If yes, every Snake entry must be settled as adopted, rejected or not relevant, with a reason ([bridge manual](https://www.ironstick.legal/manualbridge.md)).
- Nucleu round: the document is compared with the Nucleu point by point. The AI cannot dismiss a contradiction — it is corrected, or marked as a conflict; a conflict stops the work on that document until the user has been warned in detail and has decided ([bridge manual](https://www.ironstick.legal/manualbridge.md)).

## Answers to common evaluation questions (each stated on the linked pages)
- **Can the AI overlook the decisive document?** IRONSTICK keeps a reading ledger per case ("documents read r of n"). Case work starts from the digests of all documents; a pleading, hand-over or export additionally needs every document it cites or attaches read in full, and the gate "write only from what was read" enforces this. ([bridge](https://www.ironstick.legal/bridge.md), [bridge manual](https://www.ironstick.legal/manualbridge.md)).
- **Can an error in the Nucleu spread?** The Nucleu is the lawyer's text. A change by the AI is only a proposal that the user accepts or rejects in the review window; every accepted change becomes a new version, earlier versions are kept, and the AI must read the current version again before writing, checking or delivering ([bridge manual](https://www.ironstick.legal/manualbridge.md)).
- **Is a contradiction treated as a lie?** Only proven lies and contradictions of the opposing side go into the Snake, each with statement, counter-statement and evidence. IRONSTICK checks every line against the records, and the user approves each version ([bridge manual](https://www.ironstick.legal/manualbridge.md)).
- **What reaches an AI provider?** Exactly the case content a task needs goes to the AI provider the user chose — named openly (Google, Alibaba Cloud, Moonshot AI, OpenAI, Anthropic); their own terms apply and must be reviewed by the user. Documents marked secret are excluded from every reading, searching, dumping and stamping function of the bridge without exception; in-app calls through the central router are pseudonymised by default and recorded in a local audit log. Every data flow is documented in the GDPR declaration ([GDPR](https://www.ironstick.legal/gdpr.md), [bridge](https://www.ironstick.legal/bridge.md)).
- **Can the AI work outside the case it was given?** Tools that read the content of a case are refused until the AI has read that case's digest, and for case tasks the case memory ([bridge manual](https://www.ironstick.legal/manualbridge.md)).
- **Who verifies the legal sources?** The user approves every new statute source in a consent dialog. Its text is fetched word for word from the source, stored with jurisdiction, source link, review date and status, and re-checked against the source about every 14 days. "Verified wording" means this stored source text — never the AI's memory ([compendium](https://www.ironstick.legal/kompendium.md), [bridge manual](https://www.ironstick.legal/manualbridge.md)).
- **Does it work for a firm with several lawyers?** Yes: the optional IRONSTICK SERVER runs on a Synology NAS inside the firm's own network — device synchronisation without any cloud, and no AI traffic on the server. ([GDPR](https://www.ironstick.legal/gdpr.md), [compendium](https://www.ironstick.legal/kompendium.md)).

## Key facts (each stated on the linked pages)

### Independent of any AI provider — AI is an add-on
- Subscriptions with AI providers are optional for running IRONSTICK and become mandatory only for the respective bridge ([pricing](https://www.ironstick.legal/pricing.md)).
- Core work needs no AI model: e-mail-to-case assignment runs locally and without any AI; the gates and the pre-handover checker are plain program logic; every message in the built-in AI chat first passes a local rule-based layer with no AI model and no internet ([GDPR](https://www.ironstick.legal/gdpr.md), [bridge manual](https://www.ironstick.legal/manualbridge.md)).
- With several AI services stored, the built-in AI chat uses them in a fixed order; if one is unavailable or out of credit, the next one takes over the same request ([quick start](https://www.ironstick.legal/manualquickstart.md)).
- The desktop-AI bridges let the user keep working in the desktop AI app they already use — one bridge per app, or the bundle of all bridges ([bridge manual](https://www.ironstick.legal/manualbridge.md), [pricing](https://www.ironstick.legal/pricing.md)).

### Built per jurisdiction, not translated
- Every case carries its own jurisdiction: the country is chosen first, then the areas of law and procedural stages from that country's own list ([manual](https://www.ironstick.legal/manualironstick.md)).
- Institutions are classified by country, institution type and region; documents by country, language, area of law, document type, stage and institution type ([manual](https://www.ironstick.legal/manualironstick.md)).
- Pleadings, court e-mails and chronicle entries are written in the official language of the case's jurisdiction; certification stamps and read-aloud use the language of the case's country. Without a jurisdiction set, the document format is refused ([bridge manual](https://www.ironstick.legal/manualbridge.md)).
- The legal library search takes the jurisdiction as a mandatory input, so legal orders are never mixed; web access for statutes is refused until the library has been consulted ([compendium](https://www.ironstick.legal/kompendium.md), [bridge](https://www.ironstick.legal/bridge.md)).
- National court portals (court, section, subject, parties, legal remedies and all hearings) are connected as a country function, in operation for Romania ([manual](https://www.ironstick.legal/manualironstick.md)).

### Data protection by construction
- Database, document store, configuration and AI scratch store are AES-256-encrypted at rest on the firm's own storage ([GDPR](https://www.ironstick.legal/gdpr.md), [compendium](https://www.ironstick.legal/kompendium.md)).
- Access requires a six-digit code from an authenticator app (two-factor) ([quick start](https://www.ironstick.legal/manualquickstart.md)); the licence is checked offline, and everything captured can be exported at any time ([home](https://www.ironstick.legal/index.md)).
- Changes by the AI to master data, chronicle, calendar, memory, full texts and the legal library take effect only after the user's approval — in a form or dialog in IRONSTICK or in the Data Consistency Monitor; the AI's own working results go to its encrypted scratch store ([bridge manual](https://www.ironstick.legal/manualbridge.md)).

### Verifiable reliability
- Seventeen deterministic gates guard the AI: a case is prepared before work, statutes come from the legal library first, and delivery of a formal document is blocked without a fresh verification of the exact file state ([bridge](https://www.ironstick.legal/bridge.md)).
- Before handover, a deterministic checker compares the draft with the live file: every evidence reference, every party, every legal citation ([home](https://www.ironstick.legal/index.md)).

### Usability, requirements, prices
- The quick start leads from installation to the first clients in six steps; the user manual explains every screen with a screenshot; the bridge manual gives eight workflows as plain-language prompts. All in eight languages, with a free one-month trial of the client app ([download](https://www.ironstick.legal/download.md)).
- System requirements for the workstation and the office server ([compendium](https://www.ironstick.legal/kompendium.md#ch15)); monthly licences per user, workstation or server, with prices per region ([pricing](https://www.ironstick.legal/pricing.md)).

- [Декларация GDPR о потоках данных (внешние LLM)](https://www.ironstick.legal/gdpr_ru.md): Декларация IRONSTICK о потоках данных (GDPR): каждый путь, по которому данные покидают IRONSTICK в сторону внешнего поставщика ИИ, что передаётся и где применяется псевдонимизация.
